source.note: Starter means first team on ESPN’s current or earlier weekly depth chart. This retains a ruled-out starter after ESPN moves the replacement above him. ESPN is unofficial; verify final inactives before kickoff.

injuries.name: Paris Johnson Jr.
injuries.detail: Johnson (biceps) has been ruled out for the remainder of the 2026 season, Dani Sureck of the Cardinals' official site reports.

injuries.name: Isaiah Adams
injuries.detail: Adams suffered an ankle injury in Sunday's loss to the Giants, Theo Mackie of The Arizona Republic reports.

injuries.name: Jeremiyah Love
injuries.detail: Coach Mike LaFleur said Monday that Love is dealing with an ankle issue that's not related to the high-ankle sprain he tended to in August, Dani Sureck of the Cardinals' official site reports.

injuries.name: Andrew Wingard
injuries.detail: Wingard suffered a bone bruise in his knee during Sunday's 36-24 loss to the Giants, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Za'Darius Smith
injuries.detail: Smith (concussion) has been ruled out for the remainder of Monday night's game against the Saints, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

injuries.name: Jake Matthews
injuries.detail: Matthews (groin) has been downgraded to out for the rest of Monday's game against the Saints, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

injuries.name: Trey Hendrickson
injuries.detail: out

injuries.name: Marlon Humphrey
injuries.detail: Humphrey (calf) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Titans.

injuries.name: Andrew Vorhees
injuries.detail: Vorhees (foot) won't return to Sunday's game against the Titans, Brian Wacker of The Baltimore Sun reports.

injuries.name: Ronnie Stanley
injuries.detail: Stanley (toe) was able to complete Sunday's 24-18 win over Tennessee, Jonas Shaffer of TheBaltimoreBanner.com reports.

injuries.name: Lamar Jackson
injuries.detail: Head coach Jesse Minter said Monday that he's uncertain whether Jackson (ankle) will be ready to play in Sunday's game against the Falcons, Jamison Hensley of ESPN.com reports. "I don't know the chances yet," Minter said. "We're still gathering a lot of the information and the imaging and things like that, just dealing with a little bit of an ankle, and we'll kind of see where that shakes out."

injuries.name: Dee Alford

injuries.name: Ed Oliver
injuries.detail: Oliver (knee) is questionable to return against the Patriots on Sunday, Lance Lysowski of The Buffalo News reports.

injuries.name: DJ Moore
injuries.detail: Moore (shoulder) is dealing with an injury that isn't considered long-term, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Jaelan Phillips

injuries.name: Monroe Freeling
injuries.detail: Freeling (knee) could return to the field as soon as the Panthers' Week 6 game against the Buccaneers, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reported Monday.

injuries.name: Mike Jackson

injuries.name: Braxton Jones

injuries.name: Pat Surtain II

injuries.name: Pat Bryant
injuries.detail: Bryant is expected to miss "a few weeks" after spraining his right ankle in Sunday's 24-14 loss to the 49ers, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

injuries.detail: Cooper suffered a torn Achilles during Sunday's 17-14 win at Tampa Bay and will miss the rest of the season, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injuries.name: Brandon Cisse
injuries.detail: Cisse (neck) was not placed in the league's concussion protocol following Sunday's 17-14 win over the Buccaneers, Weston Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

injuries.name: Jayden Reed
injuries.detail: The Packers are expected to place Reed (neck) on injured reserve Wednesday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Tyquan Thornton
injuries.detail: Thornton is slated to undergo surgery later this week to address the dislocated left ankle he sustained in Sunday's 30-27 win over the Raiders and is facing an expected recovery timeline of 3-to-4 months, Matt Zenitz of CBSSports.com reports.

injuries.name: Rashee Rice
injuries.detail: Rice (hamstring) is believed to have sustained a "relatively minor" injury in Sunday's win over the Raiders and could be ready to play following the Chiefs' Week 5 bye, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injuries.name: Rashawn Slater
injuries.detail: Slater suffered a high-ankle sprain Sunday against the Seahawks, and he is expected to miss 4-to-6 weeks, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injuries.name: Derwin James Jr.
injuries.detail: James (hamstring) is considered week-to-week ahead of the team's Week 5 matchup with Denver, Alex Insdorf of BoltBeat.com reports.

injuries.name: Charlie Kolar

injuries.name: Donte Jackson
injuries.detail: Jackson (hamstring) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against Seattle.

injuries.name: Trevor Penning
injuries.detail: Penning (head) exited Sunday's contest against Seattle in the fourth quarter.

injuries.name: Joe Alt
injuries.detail: Alt (neck) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's matchup with the Seahawks.

injuries.name: Ladd McConkey
injuries.detail: McConkey (foot), per head coach Jim Harbaugh, is "week-to-week," Alex Insdorf of BoltBeat.com reports.

injuries.name: Jaylen Watson
injuries.detail: The Rams are hopeful that Watson (shoulder) will return to practice for Week 5 preparation, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reported Monday.

injuries.name: Aaron Donald
injuries.detail: Head coach Sean McVay is hopeful that Donald (back) will play in his team's Monday night matchup against the Bills in Week 5, Stu Jackson of the Rams' official site reports. "That's the direction it looks like it's trending in," McVay said.

injuries.name: Caleb Douglas

injuries.name: Donovan Jackson

injuries.name: Chauncey Golston

injuries.name: Quinyon Mitchell
injuries.detail: Mitchell is scheduled to undergo testing on his knee Monday after he was forced out of Sunday's 24-20 loss to the Rams, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injuries.name: Jonathan Greenard
injuries.detail: Greenard (ankle) is considered day-to-day after exiting Sunday's game against the Rams, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injuries.name: Saquon Barkley
injuries.detail: Barkley (hamstring) is considered week-to-week, though the Eagles don't view the injury as long term, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injuries.name: Jamel Dean
injuries.detail: The Steelers could be without Dean for "a couple of weeks" after he exited Thursday's 27-24 loss to the Browns due to an ankle injury, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injuries.detail: The Steelers placed Harmon (foot) on injured reserve Monday, Teresa Varley of the team's official site reports.

injuries.name: Nick Bosa
injuries.detail: Bosa (calf) is unlikely to be ready for the 49ers' Week 5 matchup against the Seahawks, Cam Inman of The San Jose Mercury News reports.

injuries.name: Kyle Juszczyk
injuries.detail: Juszczyk is believed to have sustained a sprained right knee in Sunday's 24-14 win over the Broncos and is likely to miss "several weeks," Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injuries.name: Marques Sigle
injuries.detail: Sigle is expected to miss multiple weeks due to a high-ankle injury that he sustained during the 49ers' 24-14 win over the Broncos on Sunday, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports.

injuries.detail: Buccaneers head coach Todd Bowles said that Winfield was diagnosed Monday with a "slight rib fracture" and will miss 2-to-4 weeks, Jenna Laine of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Josiah Trotter
injuries.detail: Trotter (knee) was listed as a limited participant on the Buccaneers' estimated injury report Monday, Brianna Dix of the team's official site reports.

injuries.name: Jayden Daniels
injuries.detail: Coach Dan Quinn said Monday that the Commanders are aiming for Daniels (left elbow) to have a full practice week and then start Sunday's game against the Giants, Zach Selby of the Commanders' official site reports.

injuries.name: Terry McLaurin

injuries.name: Jeremy Reaves
